title: Dunia Ka Sabse Taaqatvar Keeda! 🪲 #shorts
idea: The Horned Dung Beetle can pull 1,141 times its own body weight, making it the strongest animal on Earth relative to its size.

lines.text: Kya aapko pata hai duniya ka sabse taaqatvar jaanwar ek chhota keeda hai?
Iska naam hai Horned Dung Beetle, jo dekhne mein chhota sa hai.
Par ye apne vajan se 1,141 guna zyada vajan khinch sakta hai!
Agar kisi insaan ke paas itni taaqat aa jaye, toh kya hoga?
Wo akela banda 6 bhari double-decker buses ko aasaani se khinch lega!
Agar aapke paas ye super power hoti, toh aap pehle kya uthate?
